description: Apply only requested column renames and transformations, then validate the output against schema. Cleanup column names refer to the original headers; schema names refer to the renamed output. Transformations run in listed order. decimal_comma changes only plain numbers such as 12,50; ambiguous grouping stays unchanged. No records or columns are removed. Returned csv_text is UTF-8-compatible with CRLF record endings. One paid operation includes cleanup and validation. Spreadsheet-safe escaping is opt-in and may make numeric negative cells fail numeric validation; inspect the final report before import.

changes.description: Applied in order to explicitly named original columns only.
changes.title: Changes

rename.description: Original header to new header; simultaneous rename, no dropping columns.
rename.title: Rename

spreadsheet_safe.description: Prefix cells starting with spreadsheet formula markers with an apostrophe. Output is then revalidated; numeric negatives may fail numeric types.
spreadsheet_safe.title: Spreadsheet Safe

choices.description: Optional exact allowed strings, checked before type conversion.
choices.title: Choices

maximum.description: Inclusive numeric bound, as a decimal string. Numeric columns only.
maximum.title: Maximum

minimum.description: Inclusive numeric bound, as a decimal string. Numeric columns only.
minimum.title: Minimum

name.description: Exact, case-sensitive header after any cleanup rename.
name.title: Name

required.description: Reject an empty value. Every declared header must exist regardless.
required.title: Required

unique.description: Require non-empty raw strings to be unique within this column.
unique.title: Unique

name: clean_csv
title: Clean selected CSV columns and validate the result
